en-US.title: Going All In on AI: Hearing from EBS President Kim Yu-yeol (Part 1, Lecture)
en-US.description:
On April 22, Media Today’s monthly "Media Monthly" featured a dialogue with EBS President Kim Yoo-yeol, who is spearheading the "All-in on AI" strategy, regarding the expectations and concerns surrounding this move.

EBS, a network demonstrating resilience by recording a surplus last year despite a challenging environment of declining viewership and a shrinking advertising market, has gone "all-in" on artificial intelligence, setting "enhancing competitiveness through AI and content innovation" as the core principle of its spring reorganization. Here is a video of President Kim Yoo-yeol’s lecture on this topic. Part 2 will feature a dialogue between President Kim Yoo-yeol and Jung Min-kyung, Media Today’s reporter covering EBS.

Lecture/Dialogue: Kim Yoo-yeol, President of EBS

Date & Time: Wednesday, April 22, 2026, 7:00 PM – 9:00 PM

Location: JU CAFE, 1st Floor, Youth Culture Space JU
